title: Hearty Snappy Croatian Prawns Skewers
description: A weeknight Croatian dish featuring raw frozen prawns, dehydrated to perfection and flavored with Mediterranean spices, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and mediterranean seasoning
Add the thawed prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Dehydrate the prawns in the oven for 30 minutes
Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 10 minutes
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving
